title: Key routes
steps: Taoyuan Airport → Taipei: Airport MRT to Taipei Main; A1↔A12 single fare is {{fact:airport-mrt-a1-a12}}.
Taipei city: MRT single journeys are {{fact:metro-single-fare}}; use EasyCard for convenience rather than taxis for routine hops.

Jiufen / Shifen day: Build around Ruifang and the Pingxi/Deep Branch rail-bus network, but do not hard-code a November train/bus connection this far out. Check official TRA and local bus timetables shortly before travel. Shifen Waterfall closes at 17:00 in November (last entry 16:30), so the waterfall—not a guessed last train—sets the hard daytime constraint.
